# beowulf-fitt-22 — Fitt XXII · The Dive (lines 1473–1556)

## The lines

```
1473  Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes:
1474  ‘Geþenc nū, se mǣra maga Healfdenes,
1475  snottra fengel, nū ic eom sīðes fūs,
1476  goldwine gumena, hwæt wit geō sprǣcon,
1477  gif ic æt þearfe þīnre scolde
1478  aldre linnan, þæt ðū mē ā wǣre
1479  forðgewitenum on fæder stǣle.
1480  Wes þū mundbora mīnum magoþegnum,
1481  hondgesellum, gif mec hild nime;
1482  swylce þū ðā mādmas, þē þū mē sealdest,
1483  Hrōðgār lēofa, Higelāce onsend.
1484  Mæg þonne on þǣm golde ongitan Gēata dryhten,
1485  gesēon sunu Hrǣdles, þonne hē on þæt sinc starað,
1486  þæt ic gumcystum gōdne funde
1487  bēaga bryttan, brēac þonne mōste.
1488  Ond þū Unferð lǣt ealde lāfe,
1489  wrǣtlīc wǣgsweord wīdcūðne man
1490  heardecg habban; ic mē mid Hruntinge
1491  dōm gewyrce, oþðe mec dēað nimeð!’
1492  Æfter þǣm wordum Weder-Gēata lēod
1493  efste mid elne, — nalas andsware
1494  bīdan wolde; brimwylm onfēng
1495  hilderince. Ðā wæs hwīl dæges,
1496  ǣr hē þone grundwong ongytan mehte.
1497  Sōna þæt onfunde sē ðe flōda begong
1498  heorogīfre behēold hund missēra,
1499  grim ond grǣdig, þæt þǣr gumena sum
1500  ælwihta eard ufan cunnode.
1501  Grāp þā tōgēanes, gūðrinc gefēng
1502  atolan clommum; nō þȳ ǣr in gescōd
1503  hālan līce; hring ūtan ymbbearh,
1504  þæt hēo þone fyrdhom ðurhfōn ne mihte,
1505  locene leoðosyrcan lāþan fingrum.
1506  Bær þā sēo brimwyl[f], þā hēo tō botme cōm,
1507  hringa þengel tō hofe sīnum,
1508  swā hē ne mihte nō — hē þǣm mōdig wæs —
1509  wǣpna gewealdan, ac hine wundra þæs fela
1510  swe[n]cte on sunde, sǣdēor monig
1511  hildetūxum heresyrcan bræc,
1512  ēhton āglǣcan. Ðā se eorl ongeat,
1513  þæt hē [in] nīðsele nāthwylcum wæs,
1514  þǣr him nǣnig wæter wihte ne sceþede,
1515  nē him for hrōfsele hrīnan ne mehte
1516  fǣrgripe flōdes; fȳrlēoht geseah,
1517  blācne lēoman beorhte scīnan.
1518  Ongeat þā se gōda grundwyrgenne,
1519  merewīf mihtig; mægenrǣs forgeaf
1520  hildebille, hond sweng ne oftēah,
1521  þæt hire on hafelan hringmǣl āgōl
1522  grǣdig gūðlēoð. Ðā se gist onfand,
1523  þæt se beadolēoma bītan nolde,
1524  aldre sceþðan, ac sēo ecg geswāc
1525  ðēodne æt þearfe; ðolode ǣr fela
1526  hondgemōta, helm oft gescær,
1527  fǣges fyrdhrægl; ðā wæs forma sīð
1528  dēorum mādme, þæt his dōm ālæg.
1529  Eft wæs anrǣd, nalas elnes læt,
1530  mǣrða gemyndig mǣg Hȳlāces:
1531  wearp ðā wundenmǣl wrǣttum gebunden
1532  yrre ōretta, þæt hit on eorðan læg,
1533  stīð ond stȳlecg; strenge getrūwọde,
1534  mundgripe mægenes. Swā sceal man dôn,
1535  þonne hē æt gūðe gegān þenceð
1536  longsumne lof; nā ymb his līf cearað.
1537  Gefēng þā be eaxle — nalas for fǣhðe mearn —
1538  Gūð-Gēata lēod Grendles mōdor;
1539  brægd þā beadwe heard, þā hē gebolgen wæs,
1540  feorhgenīðlan, þæt hēo on flet gebēah.
1541  Hēo him eft hraþe andlēan forgeald
1542  grimman grāpum ond him tōgēanes fēng;
1543  oferwearp þā wērigmōd wigena strengest,
1544  fēþecempa, þæt hē on fylle wearð.
1545  Ofsæt þā þone selegyst, ond hyre seax getēah
1546  brād [ond] brūnecg; wolde hire bearn wrecan,
1547  āngan eaferan. Him on eaxle læg
1548  brēostnet brōden; þæt gebearh fēore,
1549  wið ord ond wið ecge ingang forstōd.
1550  Hæfde ðā forsīðod sunu Ecgþēowes
1551  under gynne grund, Gēata cempa,
1552  nemne him heaðobyrne helpe gefremede,
1553  herenet hearde, — ond hālig God
1554  gewēold wīgsigor; wītig Drihten,
1555  rodera Rǣdend hit on ryht gescēd
1556  ȳðelīce, syþðan hē eft āstōd.
```
